title: Archival wants closer scrutiny of mining-related activities in Cebu City

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Existing developments and mining-related activities here will undergo review as the city government looks into environmental concerns and the processing of permits, including applications for commercial sand and gravel extraction. Mayor Nestor Archival said on Friday that the review would cover existing developments and relevant permits following a Cebu City Mining Regulatory Board meeting on November 5. Archival also agreed that the city should examine the issuance of Certificates of Non-Overlap (CNOs), particularly those involving applications in upland barangays. “Right after tanan [pag]sugod gyud nako, mao na atong gipareview nga mga in-ana nga permit,” he said.
